name: MessageActions
description: Feedback toolbar for an AI response: copy to clipboard, thumbs up/down rating, and regenerate. Every action is a callback; the component holds no conversation state.
designIntent: Collect user trust signals (copy, rating, regeneration) with minimal API surface; consumers own what happens after each action.

props.name: content
props.description: Text to copy; omit to hide the copy action.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called after copy with the copied text.

props.name: onFeedback
props.description: Rating callback; selecting the active rating again passes undefined.

props.name: onRegenerate
props.description: Regeneration request; omit to hide the action.

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides for all visible labels; enables localization.

antiPatterns.title: Do not place MessageActions inside the message text flow
antiPatterns.explanation: Render it below the Message bubble so actions remain visually and semantically separate from content.

accessibility.implementation: Root has role=toolbar with an aria-label.
Rating buttons expose aria-pressed so screen readers announce selection.
All icon-only controls have accessible labels; labels are localizable.
